thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that humans possess an evolutionary aversion to cloning, preferring to follow the crowd rather than replicate successful models created by others. He illustrates this by explaining how he successfully built a fund based on Warren Buffett's discontinued zero-fee partnership structure, noting that despite the model's existence, very few others had cloned it for decades.
